notes.title: v1.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Minor fixes & Improvements based on feedback... [/h2]
[list]
[*] sfx volume menu settings fix 
[*] jetboy knockback on collisions limited to small vertical nudge - to stop jetboy being thrown into path of other enemies
[*] jetsheep now lay upside down when hit
[*] health & fuel bars now flash when limited or reducing
[/list]
[h3]Many Thx![/h3]
